next_step_summary: Local run v5 is currently the evidence gate after PR #263 restored the documented GenerateContent responseMimeType + responseJsonSchema request shape. During that run the harness showed repeated HTTP 429 rate-limit responses with provider retry hints around 41-60 seconds while fixed inter-case pacing was 15 seconds. PR #264 is an owner-authorized bounded pacing corrective only: increase REQUEST_SPACING_SECONDS from 15 to 30, leaving models, structured-output schema, prompt, corpus, strict scorer, 429/503 retry/failover, timeout, credentials and report destination unchanged. Finish and review the current local run v5 first; the 30-second pacing remains runtime-unverified until a later run uses PR #264 if another run is needed.
